judgements.reason: Image of recovery after grave illness; offers hope, though not the carer's fear.
A curse describing constant dread; restates fear with nothing to hold.
Don't despair of a cure even when illness persists; steadying hope.
Shows how much a loved one's presence helps the sick; gives the carer purpose.
Illness is common lot; cool and generic for someone scared.
Expect every disaster; harsh for a frightened person.
Share courage not despair; could read as a rebuke of their fear.
Addresses the patient's bravery, not the frightened partner.
Only restates weakness from fear; nothing to take away.
General call to trust more; loosely tied to their fear.
Describes terror and wish to escape; restates without relief.
A curse of constant dread; would deepen night panic.
Heart fluttering in horror; mirrors the feeling but offers nothing.
About glimpses of the Infinite; off-topic for night panic.
Lay down, slept, woke sustained and unafraid; calming.
Woke trembling and was held and comforted; others have known this.
Night magnifies worries; points to calm of a relaxed mind.
Buddha sleeps untroubled; distant from someone waking in panic.
Everyone wakes troubled at night, then marvels the fear was nothing; normalising.
Scattered mind in meditation; only loosely related.
Calls those who can't bear pain weaklings; harsh to someone dismissed.
Calls anxiety the disease; echoes the 'just stress' dismissal.
Painful treatment then healing; not their situation of no diagnosis.
Implies symptoms come from a feeble spirit; invalidating.
Sick need medicine; faintly supports seeking care, mostly off-target.
Everyone is mentally ill; reinforces 'it's in your head'.
Says lasting pain can't be severe; dismissive of constant pain.
Stillness brings immortality; irrelevant to unexplained pain.
About spiritual pride being healed; off-topic.
Don't give up on healing chronic illness; encourages persistence.
Meditation gives rest deeper than sleep; a possible route to relief.
Even the pierced sleep a little; thin comfort, about the Buddha.
Kept awake and uncomforted; restates the sleeplessness.
Sleepless nights harrow; real calm comes from a relaxed mind.
Sleep without struggle, trusting; gentle for an exhausted person.
'Hear nothing' is impossible advice for tinnitus.
Sleep softened grief; about sorrow, not noise or insomnia.
Short promise that rest and quietness will come; meets the longing.
Mocks hearing sounds that aren't there; risks dismissing tinnitus.
Quiet heals; generic, they cannot get quiet.
Don't ruin today fearing tomorrow; directly about waiting in dread.
Vain fear of future things; wait, healing will come.
We suffer more in imagination; don't be unhappy before the crisis.
Only the present can hurt; take it moment by moment.
About enduring pain, not the anxious wait.
Trust more, but calls anxiety near-incurable; mixed for health anxiety.
Don't be distressed by intrusive thoughts; bear them patiently.
The expected often never comes; don't rush to meet suffering.
The mind invents worst cases; temper fear with hope.
Opinion adds to pain; helpful, though may minimise a real symptom.
Plea not to die mid-life; touches lost years without consolation for them.
Promise to restore the years the locusts ate; speaks to lost years.
Sick and abandoned by friends; restates without comfort.
Illness is suffering; generic, nothing to take away.
About healing pride; off-target.
Years spent in mourning; mostly restates, faint comfort.
Illness seems pure loss but years reveal growth and new paths.
Friends at the bedside; contrasts painfully with nobody understanding.
Robbed of remaining years; restates the loss only.
Lost peace and strength, yet hope renewed each morning.
About lying to his mother; unrelated to being scammed.
About giving up lying; casts the victim as wrongdoer.
Asks pardon for sins; they were victims, not sinners.
Tells mother to stop praying; would undermine their prayer.
Opening up brings healing, but framed as confessing offences.
Can't undo the past, rely on mercy; framed around sin.
Rising from despair after sin; misframes their shame.
Plea to wash away guilt; implies they sinned.
Reframes being cheated as buying wisdom; eases 'stupid', may feel light.
Prayer for peace for the broken-hearted, but about sins.
Quip about cheated money; may feel like the laugh they fear.
Don't torment yourself that it could have been avoided.
No one is promised never to look foolish; be generous with your dignity.
Cherish what you had; poor fit for lost rent money.
Don't resent abuse; not about self-blame over a scam.
Thief's act is nothing strange; calm acceptance of being robbed.
'Less money, less trouble' is flippant about rent money.
Don't inflict pain on yourself; counters 'I deserve it'.
About resentment toward others, not self-blame.
Laughing about being cheated; feels mocking here.
Sorrow grows the self; vague for their dilemma.
Confessing to one another heals; supports reaching out.
Silence wasted me; acknowledging wrong brought forgiveness.
Plea not to be held to the sins of youth; fits a teenage wrong.
Sin always before me; mostly restates the haunting.
New actions are the true apology; answers the selfish-apology worry.
Contrition reconciles a troubled conscience; hope of pardon.
Speaker's own sad school memories; not about having harmed someone.
Schoolboy wrong later became friendship; hope from the other side.
Premise 'never gave pain' contradicts their cruelty.
Taking blame to appease another; restates the dynamic.
'You imagine them' echoes gaslighting; harmful.
Truth surfaces over time; supports trusting a clear view.
Says don't rely on memory; undermines a gaslit person.
All past actions are good; jarring after abuse.
Betrayal by one trusted; restates without help.
Forgetting as freedom; thin, they doubt memory already.
Told he was weak all his life, he reasons his way to his own strength.
Truth lies between us; feeds self-doubt.
Letting go resentment; not about rebuilding self-trust.
Honour your father; jarring given their father's harm.
Check hasty words that hurt the little ones; storm calms, grace returns.
Children as regrets; hurtful and off-point.
With a child, wilfulness fails; acting from soul restores love.
Don't provoke children; true but only a rebuke.
Plea for pardon of youthful sins; not this situation.
God ready to pardon and slow to anger; mercy and a model.
Patience with a child's failings, God's patience with ours.
Lost faith and despair; unrelated.
Don't provoke children to wrath; instruction, little comfort.
History waits for the wronged to triumph; hope of justice.
The victim's honour is not being the wrongdoer.
Enemies rejoicing over me; restates the injury.
Bully became a friend; inappropriate after assault.
Choose to forget wrongs; pressure on an assault survivor.
Don't be resentful when abused; risks dismissing their sickness.
Implies the wronged first did wrong; blames the survivor.
Public opinion matters little; tangential.
In time communities see the truth; hope amid public praise of a wrongdoer.
Suffering injustice carries no blame; doing it is worse.
Premise of never giving pain doesn't fit someone who cheated.
Can't undo the past; turn to mercy.
Contrition brings pardon and a reconciled conscience.
Sins cast behind God's back; release from anguish.
Nothing you do destroys your true nature; answers 'don't deserve'.
Don't mope over mistakes; goodness is your indestructible nature.
Sorrow grows the self; too vague.
Forgiven past wakes the heart from despair; evils that have been and are not.
God ready to pardon; mercy for one who can't forgive himself.
Remember me by kindness, not my wrongs.
